meta.name: design-code-architecture
meta.description: Guided journey from an app idea to a deliberate architecture: boundaries, domain model, data decisions, and resilience, making only the expensive-to-reverse decisions and deferring the rest. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - clean-architecture, domain-driven-design, system-design, ddia-systems, software-design-philosophy, release-it, pragmatic-programmer, 37signals-way - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (ARCHITECTURE.md, RELIABILITY.md, DESIGN-CODE-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to design a new app's architecture, choose boundaries and a domain model before building, decide monolith versus microservices, or says 'how should I structure this app'. If a codebase already exists, use remove-technical-debt (aged) or improve-code-quality (fresh prototype); if the idea is not validated, run create-business or create-app first. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 从想法到架构，逐步设计应用边界与领域模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计新应用的架构，需要系统化地做出关键决策
copy.tagline_en: Design app architecture step by step from idea to deliberate decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new app's architecture and need systematic decision-making

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步设计新应用的架构：先确定最难改的决策（如系统边界、领域模型），再处理数据、可靠性等，并把所有决定记录在项目文档中，下次可继续。
howto.when: 当你想设计新应用的架构、选择系统边界和领域模型、决定单体还是微服务，或说“how should I structure this app”时触发。如果已有代码库，请用其他技能。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新应用的架构，从边界开始。
say.note: Claude 会启动引导流程，先询问应用功能、技术栈等。

say.text: 我想决定这个应用用单体还是微服务。
say.note: Claude 会进入相关阶段，帮你分析并记录决策。

say.text: 如何划分这个应用的领域模型？
say.note: Claude 会启动领域驱动设计阶段，帮你识别限界上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you step by step to design a new app's architecture: first identify the expensive-to-reverse decisions (like boundaries, domain model), then handle data, reliability, etc., and record all decisions in project docs for resumption later.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to design a new app's architecture, choose boundaries and a domain model, decide monolith vs microservices, or say 'how should I structure this app'. If a codebase exists, use other skills.

say_en.text: Help me design the architecture for a new app, starting with boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude starts the guided journey, first asking about app purpose, stack, etc.

say_en.text: I want to decide whether this app should be a monolith or microservices.
say_en.note: Claude enters the relevant phase to analyze and record the decision.

say_en.text: How should I model the domain for this app?
say_en.note: Claude starts the domain-driven design phase to identify bounded contexts.
